analysis.summary: Alivus Life reported a 16% YoY revenue increase in Q2 FY27, driven by strong demand in regulated markets and a significant 79.9% YoY growth in the CDMO segment. The company achieved an EBITDA margin of 41.8%, supported by a favorable product mix and operational efficiencies. Management is executing a multi-phase capacity expansion plan across Ankleshwar, Dahej, and Solapur to reach a total reactor capacity of 2,690 KL by FY29. Strong free cash flow generation has resulted in a cash balance of ₹10,116 million as of September 30, 2026. Alivus Life Sciences reported a 6.4% year-on-year revenue growth in Q1 FY27, driven by a 26.5% increase in its non-GPL business which offset a 52.6% decline in the GPL segment.

guidance.claim: Management expects ongoing capacity expansion and a healthy development pipeline to sustain growth momentum.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, our ongoing capacity expansion and healthy development pipeline give us confidence in sustaining this momentum and delivering consistent growth.

guidance.claim: The company expects revenue growth of 10% to 12% for FY27, with performance weighted toward the second half.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management aims to sustain EBITDA margins within the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: The GPL business is expected to remain flattish for the full fiscal year 2027.
guidance.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year

guidance.claim: The CDMO segment is projected to gain momentum in the second half of FY27.
guidance.quote: However, we can expect the segment to gain momentum in the second half of the year, supported by contributions from newly added projects.

guidance.claim: Steady state R&D expenditure is targeted at approximately 4% of revenue.
guidance.quote: So we should sort of end up at a steady state of around 4%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of achieving revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: With a continued strong growth momentum in the non-GPL portfolio and muted growth in the GPL business, we remain confident of achieving revenue growth of 10% - 12% in FY27, while sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30%–32% range.

guidance.claim: Management expects the GPL business to be flattish in FY27.
guidance.quote: GPL business is expected to be flattish in FY27, despite a significant decline in Q1FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue growth was supported by healthy demand across all key markets and contributions from recent launches.
demand_outlook.quote: Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: Non-GPL business grew 26.5% due to new product launches and strong demand across geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business experienced a significant decline due to inventory rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

demand_outlook.claim: Chronic therapies accounted for 74% of the total top line in the first quarter.
demand_outlook.quote: Overall, chronic therapies accounted for 74% of top line in Q1 FY '27.

demand_outlook.claim: CVS and CNS therapies together contributed 58% of the company's revenue.
demand_outlook.quote: Turning to the therapeutic mix, CVS and CNS continued to anchor growth during the quarter, together contributing 58% to the top line.

capex_expansion.claim: A brownfield expansion at Ankleshwar is planned to add approximately 100 KL of capacity by Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add 160 KL of API capacity at Dahej by Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API Dahej Planned addition of ~160KL Capacity Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the Solapur expansion is expected to add 125 KL of API/Pharma block capacity by Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Greenfield Solapur Phase 2 - ~125 KL (API / Pharma block) Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: A third phase of expansion at Solapur is planned to add 535 KL by FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 3 - Planned addition of ~535 KL FY29

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of a new R&D facility in Taloja is currently in progress.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our new R&D facility in Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is progressing steadily.

capex_expansion.claim: The Solapur facility is expected to become operational in early Q3 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction has started on a new R&D center at Taloja.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: Brownfield expansions are underway at the Dahej and Ankleshwar sites.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean we have Dahej, Ankleshwar which are reg sites and Mohol. And we are comfortably able to manage the business now because even there is a brownfield expansion happening in Ankleshwar as well as in Dahej

capex_expansion.claim: Dahej is adding 160KL of capacity while Ankleshwar is adding 110KL.
capex_expansion.quote: So Dahej is getting 160KL and Ankleshwar is getting like 110KL.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction has begun for a new R&D facility in Taloja.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction has begun for the new R&D facility in Taloja (Navi Mumbai) to establish a state-of-the-art R&D centre.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to add 100KL of capacity at Ankleshwar in Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

margins_costs.claim: Gross margin increased to 64.4% due to a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: Gross margins improved to 60.2% driven by product mix and operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: On the profitability front, a favourable product mix and newer launches helped improve gross margins to 60.2%, an increase in 510 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins reached 36.6% supported by operational efficiency and forex gains.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material prices have increased, and the company has partially passed these costs to customers.
margins_costs.quote: So there has been an increase in raw material prices. It's not been very steep and we have managed to pass on a part of it to our customers.

margins_costs.claim: The company is implementing membrane-based technology to improve solvent recovery by 5% to 10%.
margins_costs.quote: Recently, I mean, we introduced a membrane-based technology apart from just regular distillation, okay? And that is proving to be pretty effective. So we might scale that up. But again, we might improve by about 5% to 10% there on recovery.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter were 36.6%, signifying better operational efficiencies.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA Margins for the quarter were at 36.6%, up 220 bps QoQ & 650 bps YoY, signifying better operational efficiencies.

orders_capacity.claim: The HP API portfolio includes 30 products in the active development grid.
orders_capacity.quote: The HP API portfolio continues to progress steadily, with 30 products in the active development grid with a TAM of ~$86 bn

orders_capacity.claim: The Ankleshwar facility has an annual installed capacity of 950.2 KL.
The Dahej facility has an annual installed capacity of 399.9 KL.
The company has 617 global DMF and CEP filings as of June 30.
orders_capacity.quote: The pipeline remains robust, with 617 DMF and CEP filings globally as on June 30.

orders_capacity.claim: The high-potent API portfolio includes 29 products with a total addressable market of $82 billion.
orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

orders_capacity.claim: The company is currently engaged in active discussions for seven new CDMO projects.
orders_capacity.quote: So CDMO, we have active discussions with almost about 7 projects right now, okay?

orders_capacity.claim: The company has filed 617 DMFs and CEPs across major global markets.
orders_capacity.quote: Filed 617 DMFs and CEPs across major markets; United States, Europe, Japan, Russia, Brazil, South Korea, Taiwan, Canada, China and Australia

capital_allocation.claim: ROICE expanded to approximately 34%, reflecting strong asset productivity.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE expanded to ~34% – underscoring strong asset productivity and disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Asset turnover remained above 2x despite the ongoing capex cycle.
capital_allocation.quote: FATR is 2.1 times – Asset turns remained above 2x despite the impact of the ongoing capex cycle.

capital_allocation.claim: Alivus Life Sciences remains a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

capital_allocation.claim: Return on Invested Capital (ROICE) is tracking at approximately 32%.
capital_allocation.quote: ROICE is tracking at ~32% – Capital employed was driven by a calibrated Capex strategy

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical conflicts are causing volatility in raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: The issue is this war situation, and what it's doing to raw material prices. So we need to be a little bit cautious.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company expects a slight increase in inventory to manage price predictability for customers.
risks_headwinds.quote: There will be a slight increase on the inventory side is what we are seeing as we keep on building inventory so that we are able to continue to support our customers in a timely manner and at more predictable prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: The Solapur facility has experienced minor construction delays.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the capex front, Solapur continues to progress as planned. There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

risks_headwinds.claim: The GPL business experienced a significant decline in the first quarter of FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: GPL business is expected to be flattish in FY27, despite a significant decline in Q1FY27.

risks_headwinds.claim: Asset turns have trended slightly lower due to the current capital expenditure cycle.
risks_headwinds.quote: FATR is 2.2 times – Asset turns have trended slightly lower due to the Capex cycle
